cause_quote: The controller changed `settle()` from `Promise<void>` to `Promise<"normal" | "cooperative" | "forced" | "uncertain">` and added `return cleanup;`, while extension exec still discarded the return value and resolved an ordinary result.
user_saw: An extension author received an ordinary command result after cancellation even though a descendant was still running.
summary: Extension exec now throws `CommandProcessCleanupError` when cleanup is uncertain and preserves the root command result and captured output in the error’s cause.
reasoning: I checked that extension exec already awaited a void settlement before #139517 and kept the same call when the controller began returning a cleanup verdict. The extension API therefore discarded uncertainty from the first version of that verdict. The follow-up #139957 added the specific case where the process group stays alive after a forced stop, which the same call also ignored.
